claim_under_audit: The full-series thesis can make revisability the supreme good.
mandatory_boundary: The text values the right to revise without requiring endless revision; durable commitments can be legitimate goods.

claim_under_audit: Open futurity is a minimum threshold for moral standing.
mandatory_boundary: T02 already separates flourishing from standing; Sirin/Fido/Legion cases prevent this threshold.

claim_under_audit: Strong durable identity is presumptively enclosure.
mandatory_boundary: Eighty-Six pride, chosen vocation, promises, names, love, and retained objects can remain strong without exhausting the person.

claim_under_audit: Recoverability can function as one unqualified full-series master metaphor.
mandatory_boundary: T12 splits return among homeward, state-restorative, deathward, and operational lexical systems; some losses are irreversible.

claim_under_audit: Returning to a prior state is inherently positive.
mandatory_boundary: V14 imperial restoration is the direct negative control; restoration can be reactionary.

claim_under_audit: Purpose-capture explains every intense commitment.
mandatory_boundary: Chosen love, profession, promise, pride, and military duty can be strong and persistent while answer-space remains.

claim_under_audit: Eighty-Six pride is latent pathology gradually outgrown.
mandatory_boundary: V01 anti-dehumanization function and V14 retained pride are decisive counterevidence.

claim_under_audit: Healthy identity is always maximally plural.
mandatory_boundary: Plurality protects against enclosure, but coherence and long endurance are also valued; no quota of identities is textually established.

claim_under_audit: Initial consent is sufficient to make a binding healthy.
mandatory_boundary: Consent matters, but continuing capacity to reinterpret, refuse, or renegotiate remains necessary.

claim_under_audit: Support is healthy whenever it helps or protects.
mandatory_boundary: Care can become pity, guardianship, surveillance, hostage logic, or saviorism; judgment must normally be returned.

claim_under_audit: Interruption is inherently agency-preserving.
mandatory_boundary: Interruption is positive when bounded by incapacity/emergency and followed by returned judgment; otherwise it can become domination.

claim_under_audit: Shin/Lena is a purely non-possessive relationship.
mandatory_boundary: The relationship is usually future- and agency-bearing but includes possessive rhetoric, fear, dependency, asymmetry, and hostage vulnerability.

claim_under_audit: Romance is the causal owner of Shin recovery.
mandatory_boundary: Ordinary capacities, Spearhead, Fido, Rei, professional practice, curiosity, medicine, and civic structures predate or coexist with romance.

claim_under_audit: Distributed command makes individual excellence unimportant.
mandatory_boundary: V14 proves operations can survive Shin absence while preserving the exceptional value of his specific capability.

claim_under_audit: The series is anti-heroic.
mandatory_boundary: Heroic action is admired; permanent institutional dependence on heroic singularity is the target.

claim_under_audit: Post-rescue reenlistment proves military vocation is wholly free of conditioning.
mandatory_boundary: Civilian capability is real, but developmental history and war-made identity continue to shape preference.

claim_under_audit: Remaining a soldier proves failure to recover.
mandatory_boundary: Civilianization is not the normative endpoint; exclusive destiny is the problem.

claim_under_audit: Disability is either pure tragedy or automatic liberation.
mandatory_boundary: Theo loses real capabilities and gains new options; neither restoration nor injury itself supplies the moral meaning.

claim_under_audit: Medical protection is inherently freedom-enhancing.
mandatory_boundary: Treatment can preserve agency, but protective retention of a useful body can reproduce functional captivity.

claim_under_audit: Future orientation naturally cures self-instrumentalization.
mandatory_boundary: V14 Shin wants a future while concealing serious sensory loss to protect frontline function.

claim_under_audit: Combat competence establishes adult status.
mandatory_boundary: War produces asymmetrical development; adult duties of protection remain.

claim_under_audit: Nonrevenge culminates in forgiveness.
mandatory_boundary: V11 and V14 explicitly permit nonrevenge with continuing nonforgiveness and legal accountability.

claim_under_audit: Legal punishment is sufficient repair.
mandatory_boundary: Punishment is one bounded response; record, vindication, compensation, reconstruction, and reform remain distinct.

claim_under_audit: Democratic/liberal institutions prevent moral collapse.
mandatory_boundary: Giad can regress; their value lies more in corrigibility and retained routes of accountability than immunity.

claim_under_audit: Capability scaffolding is sufficient for self-government.
mandatory_boundary: Education/resources enable judgment but do not guarantee wise exercise or willingness to judge.

claim_under_audit: Human fallibility justifies permanent guardianship.
mandatory_boundary: V14 is the decisive falsifier: intermittent foolishness cannot be converted into hereditary denial of words, will, or freedom.

claim_under_audit: A later Sector analogy implies historical equivalence to San Magnolia.
mandatory_boundary: Structural relation and historical genealogy must remain distinct.

claim_under_audit: Recognizing someone as human prevents disposability.
mandatory_boundary: The Fawns show recognized human bodies can still be assigned a duty to absorb danger or disappear.

claim_under_audit: Dangerous embodiment creates a duty to die.
mandatory_boundary: Risk can justify proportionate safeguards, not automatic moral cancellation of continued existence.

claim_under_audit: Artificial origin is evidence of inferior standing.
mandatory_boundary: Origin, substrate, memory, will, refusal, personality, and purpose constraints must be assessed separately.

claim_under_audit: Home is purely chosen rather than inherited.
mandatory_boundary: Origin, homeland, citizenship, blood relation, memory, household, and chosen destination can coexist in plural relation.

claim_under_audit: Citizenship is superficial compared with authentic belonging.
mandatory_boundary: V01 denaturalization proves legal membership is materially indispensable even though it is insufficient for felt home.

claim_under_audit: Preserving memory is inherently healthy.
mandatory_boundary: Counter-archive can preserve persons, but memory can also monopolize action, demand imitation, or become grievance purpose.

claim_under_audit: The visual/motif system can be read through stable symbolic equivalences.
mandatory_boundary: T13 shows object biographies and context-sensitive reuse are stronger than fixed dictionaries.

claim_under_audit: Visual evidence is intrinsically more truthful than narrated interpretation.
mandatory_boundary: V13 demonstrates true footage can be made to tell a false causal story.

claim_under_audit: V14 closes the series current major arguments.
mandatory_boundary: V14 explicitly opens the final arc and leaves constitutional, relational, bodily, and posthuman outcomes unresolved.

claim_under_audit: No Face equals Vaclav with mechanism fully established.
mandatory_boundary: Identity direction is near-conclusive, but incorporation/continuity mechanism remains unresolved at V14 boundary.

claim_under_audit: Lyudmila fear of death can be generalized to Sirins as a class.
mandatory_boundary: It is strong evidence of emergent end-pressure in one subject, not a universal Sirin rule.

claim_under_audit: Frederica throne and Shin War Emperor titles establish their free political choice.
mandatory_boundary: Consent, coercion, symbolism, emergency role, and actual constitutional power remain unknown.

claim_under_audit: Political recoverability is guaranteed because Shin believes people can come back.
phase5_disposition: REJECTED AS GUARANTEE / OPEN AS POSSIBILITY
mandatory_boundary: The grammar is modal possibility, and institutions may fail to realize it.

claim_under_audit: Peace will resolve the becoming problem by stabilizing identity.
mandatory_boundary: The series has not yet shown postwar life; peace itself could become another fixed order if agency and exit disappear.
